content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets through traditional platforms often means sacrificing a significant portion of your profits to fees. For instance, if you're selling a $97 product and making 100 sales a month on Gumroad, you'd be losing $970 annually just to transaction fees. In contrast, utilizing a crypto payment solution like NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%, means you retain $921 more per month. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-crypto-honest-side-side-25|COREMERCH guide to financial]] advantage allows digital creators to reinvest in their work, build their brand, and enhance their offerings without the shackles of platform dependency.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for selling design assets without traditional payment platforms relies on a combination of free tools that work seamlessly together. This includes using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your digital storefront, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for processing crypto transactions. Each component plays a crucial role: hosting ensures your products are accessible, backend logic automates delivery, and NOWPayments verifies payments without hefty fees. This architecture provides a robust, reliable framework that empowers creators to operate independently.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in markets where conventional payment processors are either unavailable or heavily restricted. Countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe face unique challenges in online commerce, making it imperative to have a sovereign infrastructure that allows for direct sales without intermediary costs. By adopting this framework, creators can maintain control over their sales processes, reduce costs, and focus on what truly matters: creating high-quality digital products that resonate with their audience.
Retain more revenue by avoiding high platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To effectively sell design assets with crypto payments, several key components must work in harmony. The Sovereign Starter Stack provides the foundational setup, while the Edge Commerce Stack enhances functionality with added features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for email deliverability. Supabase or Google Sheets can serve as databases to track orders, and cloud storage solutions like Google Drive ensure instant product delivery. Each piece is vital for creating a frictionless buying experience, allowing customers to receive their purchases immediately after payment confirmation.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Deploying your own digital storefront is straightforward. Start by choosing a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate processes. Integrate NOWPayments for payment processing to ensure you only pay a 0.5% fee for transactions. Populate your store with your design assets, and ensure you have a clear pathway for product delivery using Google Drive. Finally, launch your site and start selling your products directly to customers.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a combination of free hosting services and automated backend solutions. By leveraging tools like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, you can create a fully operational store that doesn't rely on traditional payment platforms, maximizing your revenue potential.
Own your digital storefront and eliminate dependency on third-party platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions

You can sell an ebook by hosting your own storefront using free tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Integrate a crypto payment processor like NOWPayments to handle transactions seamlessly.

The best way is to leverage a combination of open-source tools for hosting and backend automation, allowing you to retain most of your revenue while using low-cost payment processing through crypto.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, by using your own site set up on platforms like GitHub Pages and integrating NOWPayments, you can sell templates and fonts directly without incurring the high fees associated with traditional platforms.
What are the advantages of using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments offers low transaction fees of just 0.5% and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. This means you can accept payments in various digital currencies without the hassle of KYC requirements.
How can I ensure my digital products are delivered instantly?
Using cloud storage solutions like Google Drive allows you to set up automated delivery systems that trigger upon payment confirmation, ensuring customers receive their products immediately.
